claims.object_text: not significantly associated with PD risk
claims.quote: None of the 6 SNPs were significantly associated with PD risk on their own.

claims.object_text: reduced PD risk in conjunction with putative low-risk GRIN1 genotypes
claims.quote: in conjunction with putative low-risk genotypes for the GRIN1 gene, the GRIN2BC366G variant was significantly associated with reduced PD risk compared with the homozygous genotype 366CC (OR=0.38, 95%CI=0.17-0.93, P=0.033).

claims.object_text: synergistic reduction in PD risk when multiple GRIN1 polymorphisms are present with GRIN2BC366G
claims.quote: A synergistic effect on risk reduction was observed in subjects who carried multiple polymorphisms of GRIN1 and the GRIN2BC366G polymorphism (OR=0.78, 95%CI=0.59-1.02, P(trend)=0.073).

claims.object_text: may serve as potential biomarkers for a reduced risk of PD
claims.quote: Our results suggest that polymorphisms in the GRIN1 and GRIN2B genes may serve as potential biomarkers for a reduced risk of PD among the Chinese population in Taiwan.
